At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with tender administration teams:

Tender administration
  Delegated: Retrieve the tender pack, organise translations and map the response to the submission requirements.
  Stays with you: The bid owner approves pricing, final representations and submission.
  Exception: An invitation refers to a separate technical pack.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.

See the tender administration workflow: https://uieglobal.com/solutions/tender-administration/?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t1-tender
